create_PolarsColumn: create a PolarsColumn instance backed by a Polars Series with an optional allow_copy flag
get_column_dtype: get the interchange-compatible data type of a PolarsColumn from its underlying Series
get_column_buffers: get the underlying data, validity, and offsets buffers from a PolarsColumn as PolarsBuffer tuples
describe_categorical_column: describe categorical or enum columns with is_ordered, is_dictionary, and categories from a PolarsColumn
iterate_column_chunks: iterate over column chunks of a PolarsColumn, optionally merging them into a specified number of subchunks
